requirements.text: Retries never double-count; adoption verifies identity/trust without recompute.
Durable units monotonic and once; replays idempotent.
Failed/gapped outputs never publish campaign success; consumers refuse gapped payloads.
Class-tag conjunction eligibility; host-pair tags admitting neither box are plan errors.
Adoption caps trust at source mode; adopted pool-declared never becomes staged-verified without promotion re-verification.
RAM preferred, explicit SSD allowed, no HDD bulk opens; readiness and tier-enforcement audited separately.
Metadata allowance is bounded header/index/control bytes; get_slice and any payload-materializing call are data readers.
Boundary/activation bulk in read set and dependency graph or unsupported-workset; unstaged boundary reads are explicit gap; dynamic artifacts planned after durable receipt.
No waiver checkbox; legacy pool reads need explicit scoped user authorization on the sealed request; payloads stay pool-declared.
Releasable safe frontier established separately from durable compute progress.
Exact read plan with repeats; lookahead fit proven pre-admission or unsupported-workset refused.

requirements.text: Typed waits (fit-lack vs oversize); initial-phase wait before GPU admission; mid-phase grace with terminal reason on stall.
Formal inequality over competing consumers or deterministic policy guaranteeing one admissible next step; no agent scheduler.
No whole-working-set RAM requirement; windows are the unit of fit.
Conditional liveness on stated fairness/finite-IO premises with NFS limitation honest; queue timeout implies neither withdrawal nor containment.
Dev disables giant resealing and per-unit source walks.
Missing/changed evidence refuses reuse or opens explicit new lineage; never hidden whole-model hashing nor stamp-and-trust.
Small binding checks and integrity-on-copy always on, distinct from expensive sealing.
Dev results carry dev_uncertified plus tree digest; certified gate demands end-artifact evidence.
Cross-host source identity; until proven, same-host re-verification stated as incomplete.
No eviction of a live lease.
No bulk-input read from a forbidden tier.
